title: 奈米壓印微影
summary: 以四階段、24 個工程判讀工作包，逐步研究模板與樹脂、填充與對位、固化與脫模、缺陷與轉移；每步交付圖表、對照、計算或驗證紀錄。
summaryEn: Work through 24 engineering investigations in four stages: template and resin, filling and alignment, curing and release, defects and transfer. Each step produces a diagram, comparison, calculation or verification record.
scope: 依公開原理編寫的教學課程；24 步是研究與工程判讀任務，不是完整晶圓廠配方或設備操作指令。自訂數據須標示假設，數值不代表任何廠商製程。課程內容完整提供繁體中文與英文。
scopeEn: Educational investigations based on public principles. These 24 steps are research and engineering-review tasks, not complete fab recipes or equipment operating instructions. Hypothetical data must be labeled and do not represent any vendor process. Full content is supplied in Traditional Chinese and English.

steps.title: 依局部圖案體積規畫滴液分布
steps.titleEn: Plan droplets using local pattern volume
steps.objective: 透過本步證據判讀：均勻滴液未必得到均勻殘留層。
steps.objectiveEn: Use this investigation to assess the following principle: Uniform droplets need not yield uniform residual layers.
steps.instruction:

具體演算（全部數據為教學假設）：假設模板凹槽總體積 100 μm³，壓印區面積 1000 μm²，目標殘留層厚度 0.020 μm。理想所需樹脂體積為 100+1000×0.020=120 μm³。若滴入 140 μm³且完全填充、沒有流出或收縮，殘留層為 (140-100)/1000=0.040 μm，即 40 nm。實際還需評估氣泡、收縮與局部密度，不能只用總體積保證均勻。
steps.instructionEn:
Plan droplets using local pattern volume. Read the step sources and identify their actual material, pattern or tool scope. Complete the task using an educational sketch or explicitly hypothetical data. Attach a diagram labeled with materials, directions and scales; circle one quantity not inferable from the drawing alone. Finally check your inference against this principle: Uniform droplets need not yield uniform residual layers.

Worked example (all values are teaching assumptions): Assume 100 μm³ of template-cavity volume, 1000 μm² imprint area and a target 0.020 μm residual layer. Ideal resin volume is 100+1000×0.020=120 μm³. Dispensing 140 μm³ with complete filling and no outflow or shrinkage yields (140-100)/1000=0.040 μm, or 40 nm, residual thickness. Bubbles, shrinkage and local density still matter; total volume does not guarantee uniformity.
